text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! What is it? I'm so sleepy
that if I stop moving, I'll totally pass out!
So I'm just dancing for now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Though if I stop running,
the exhaustion's just gonna make me even sleepier.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever! As long as I'm dancing, I can stay awake!

It looks like her fatigue has reached its limit.
We ought to reconsider her race schedule.
